skill.displayName: Logo Remover from Video – Remove Video Logos Online Free – API-powered
skill.summary: Logo remover from video — remove logos or watermarks from a video

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the logo-remover-from-video skill.
- Remove logos or watermarks from videos using the WeShop OpenAPI service.
- Requires a WESHOP_API_KEY, with guidance on API key security and environment variable usage.
- Includes endpoints for starting runs, polling status, and uploading images.
- Supports input of video URLs and optional watermark detection mode (autoDetect by default).
- Provides details on polling for completion and accessing processed video results.
